Who saw the petals
drop from the rose?
I, said the spider,
But nobody knows.
Who saw the sunset
flash on a bird?
I, said the fish,
But nobody heard.
Who saw the fog

I, said the sea pigeon,

Who saw the first

The only one.
Who saw the moss
creep over the stone?
I, said the gray fox,
All alone.
